name: ck-marketplace
description: ckandrinirina's Claude Code marketplace: ck-code (spec-driven design → plan → build → ship workflow with per-project experts and tech guides), ck-code-lite (the same workflow trimmed to four skills and two files), ck-tools (repo-level utility skills — dependency upgrades, releases, issue/PR helpers — and a band with your 5-hour and weekly plan limits and pace) and ck-oneshot (build a whole new project in one run from its documents, then hand it over to ck-code-lite).

plugins.name: ck-code
plugins.description: Spec-driven workflow plugin: design, plan, build, ship, with per-project experts and tech guides.

plugins.name: ck-code-lite
plugins.description: Minimal four-skill workflow: start (architecture + flat plan), build (failing test first, isolated QA, manual sign-off), ship (commit + PR), design (optional Claude Design hand-off). The ck-code guarantees without the ceremony. An alternative to ck-code, not a companion.

plugins.name: ck-tools
plugins.description: Utility toolkit plugin: dependency upgrades, audits, snapshots, and other repo-level chores, plus a band above the prompt with your 5-hour and weekly plan limits and pace. Coexists with ck-code.

plugins.name: ck-oneshot
plugins.description: One-shot project builder: reads a spec, PRD, architecture or idea, asks once, builds the whole project in waves of subagents with a model per unit, verifies install, typecheck, build, lint and boot, then hands over in ck-code-lite's layout for adjustments. Also fixes a batch of issues in an existing project the same way.
